summary: Given a global packed-array index a2, walks the packed array entries (64-byte stride) accumulating each entry's element-size field to find which entry contains a2, then returns a pointer to the sub-element at offset a2 - entryStart within that entry. Returns 0 if the element count at this+0x118 is non-positive or if a2 falls outside every entry's cumulative range.

local_names.this: packed-array container object (element count at this+0x118, base pointer at this+0x11C)
local_names.a2: global index into the packed array being resolved
local_names.v3: running sum of entry sizes (cumulative start of the current entry)
local_names.v5: current entry index within the packed array
local_names.i: loop byte cursor advancing by 64 per entry

operations.description: If the element count this[70] (this+0x118) is not greater than 0, skip the search loop and return the default result 0.
Iterate entries v5 = 0, 1, ... while the requested index a2 is outside the current entry's range, i.e. while a2 < v3 or a2 >= v3 + entrySize; advance the byte cursor i by 64 (entry stride) each step.
Accumulate the entry sizes: v3 += the size field at this[71] + i + 8, extending the cumulative range by the current entry.
If the entry counter v5 reaches the element count v2 without containing a2, abandon the search and return 0.
Compute the sub-element address: entry base this[71] + (v5 << 6) + 12, then add 48 * (a2 - v3) to index the requested sub-element within the entry.
Return the resolved sub-element pointer; return the default 0 when the count guard or the not-found guard fired.

Invoked on frame paths by GlobalVectorOffsetUpdate (0x0040E1F0), ParticleCollisionSpawn (0x004C9FB0), CameraViewportRenderSetup (0x004FBD70) and eleven other callers to resolve packed-array sub-elements by global index.

unresolved: The byte meaning of the 64-byte entry layout (size field at +8, payload header at +12, 48-byte sub-element stride) is derived from the decompiled arithmetic and not independently confirmed.
Semantic roles of the returned sub-element (vertex, AABB, color, etc.) differ per caller and are not established here.
